packageRules.description: A major version is a change to read, not a PR to wave through: it waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, as .github/dependabot.yml leaves majors to a person.
cedar-policy-symcc pins cedar-policy exactly and the proofs are built against one Cedar version, so the Cedar crates move as one change, approved on the Dependency Dashboard and proved in CI.
An SDK's dependency bump is not release-notes material, so the changelog gate is told so up front.
